paidCourses.name: 100 Days of Code: The Complete Python Pro Bootcamp
paidCourses.subject: Python
paidCourses.why: Consider this if you learn by making things and want a sequence of small Python projects.
paidCourses.learn: Python foundations, automation, games, web apps and introductory data projects.
paidCourses.before: A computer, internet access and time for regular coding practice. No previous programming is required.

instructor.name: Dr. Angela Yu
instructor.role: Developer & lead instructor, The App Brewery
instructor.bio: Angela Yu moved from medicine into programming education and founded the London App Brewery. Her teaching grew from classroom workshops into online courses. Her project-based curriculum includes Python, web development and app development.
instructor.teachingNote: Her July 2016 interview describes teaching in a London classroom. This is a documented milestone, not a claim that she first started that year.

paidCourses.name: Complete Web Development Course
paidCourses.subject: Web development
paidCourses.why: Consider this for a broad path from building web pages to working on full-stack projects.
paidCourses.learn: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind, React, Node.js, databases, Git and deployment.
paidCourses.before: A laptop or desktop and time to build alongside the lessons. Start with the foundations if you are new to coding.

instructor.name: Hitesh Choudhary
instructor.bio: Hitesh Choudhary founded LearnCodeOnline, which was acquired, and previously worked as CTO at iNeuron and Senior Director at Physics Wallah. He now teaches programming through YouTube, Udemy and ChaiCode cohorts, and builds developer tools and open-source projects.
instructor.teaching: Exact teaching start year not confirmed
instructor.teachingNote: The reviewed official biographies do not state a teaching start year. His course mentions 15+ years of coding experience; coding experience is not the same as teaching experience.
milestones: Former CTO, iNeuron · former Senior Director, PW

paidCourses.name: Machine Learning Specialization
paidCourses.subject: AI & machine learning
paidCourses.why: Consider this if you want a structured introduction to how machine learning models work, with Python exercises.
paidCourses.learn: Regression, classification, neural networks, decision trees, clustering and recommender systems across three courses.
paidCourses.before: Basic Python and school-level algebra are useful preparation. Review the provider’s current prerequisites and sample lessons.

instructor.name: Andrew Ng
instructor.role: AI educator · lead instructor with a teaching team
instructor.bio: Andrew Ng is a computer scientist and educator who co-founded Coursera and founded DeepLearning.AI. His career includes AI research at Stanford and work with Google Brain and Baidu. He leads this specialization alongside its other instructors.
instructor.teaching: Open online ML course launched in 2011
instructor.teachingNote: Coursera documents the 2011 launch of his Stanford online machine learning course. His university teaching predates this online milestone.

paidCourses.name: Figma UI UX Design Essentials
paidCourses.subject: Design & UX
paidCourses.why: Consider this for a practical introduction to Figma and turning a design brief into an interactive prototype.
paidCourses.learn: Personas, wireframes, typography, components, prototypes and handoff to developers.
paidCourses.before: A computer and a Figma account. The course starts from the basics; no previous UX experience is assumed.

instructor.name: Daniel Walter Scott
instructor.role: Founder & chief instructor, Bring Your Own Laptop
instructor.bio: Daniel Walter Scott began in art and digital design before building Bring Your Own Laptop. He is an Adobe Certified Instructor who teaches design and digital media. His provider biography reports teaching awards at Adobe MAX, and his courses emphasise practical creative projects.
instructor.teaching: 14+ years teaching, per his Udemy biography
instructor.teachingNote: This is the instructor’s published experience claim. The profile does not give an exact starting year, so no year is inferred from it.
milestones: Art studies → digital and media design
